metadata.title: Basic Geometry
metadata.subtitle: Points, Lines, and Rays!
metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity AI
learning_outcomes: Differentiate between points, lines, line segments, and rays

ai_context.learning_goal: Teach the foundational building blocks of geometry.
common_misconceptions: Confusing a line segment with a line
ai_context.tutor_hint: Draw arrows to emphasize infinity for lines and rays.

content.text: A LINE goes on forever in both directions (like a road with no end). A LINE SEGMENT is a piece of a line with two stopping points.

content.question: Which of these has two endpoints and does NOT go on forever?
content.explanation: A line segment has two distinct endpoints!

content.text: A RAY starts at one point and goes on forever in only ONE direction. Think of a laser beam coming out of a flashlight!

content.question: How many endpoints does a Ray have?
content.explanation: A ray has exactly one starting endpoint, and goes on forever the other way.
